Treatment summary
Patient presented after a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of
motion. Over three visits, the injury was assessed as consistent with the mechanism of the crash, and the clinical course followed
a typical pattern of gradual improvement, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms eased. On examination, several findings
supoprt a soft tissue injury to the shoulder, while other orthopedic and neurological tests were within normal limits. The records
also show a prior history of treatment to the same shoulder region within the last two years, and that earlier condition appears to
contribute to some of the current complaints. Billing for the episode reflects single charges for each service, with no repeated or
duplicate entries. Continued home exercise and over-the-counter analgesia were recommended, with follow-up as needed should
symtpoms return.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
